analysis: NKT lymphocytes, or Natural Killer T cells, are a unique subset of T cells that recognize lipid antigens presented by CD1d molecules. They have T cell receptors (TCRs) and are known for their ability to recognize lipid antigens. While they can produce various cytokines, their recognition of lipids bound to CD1 molecules is a defining characteristic.
